// Systems I designed for it

Onboarding

Foundation Handler System

Trusted members claim each new sign-up within 24h, run their first scene, and check in at day 3 and 30. Success = still active after 30 days. Directly attacks new-member drop-off.

Governance

Tiered ruleset & enforcement

Full rules with four severity tiers, escalation paths, a discretion clause, and appeals. Age policy and safety built in from day one.

Onboarding UX

Orientation packet & cheatsheet

A complete new-member guide plus a one-page reference, so a newcomer goes from confused to posting without asking staff.

Events

Event design & GM playbook

Step-by-step event process and detailed live briefings that keep large group events organised and readable.

03 / CASE STUDY — CRIMSON NETWORK

Scaling and running a live gaming network

Crimson Network is an international multi-game community. I joined the leadership as Staff Manager and sat on the Board of Directors — building the systems and structure that let a large server run day to day.

Role: Staff Manager · Board of Directors
Peak: ~1,400 members
Scope: systems · moderation · partnerships
  • Staff structure & moderation: built a self-organising staff team with department heads; ran moderator recruitment and standards.
  • Progression & roles: designed the leveling system and role hierarchy that reward activity.
  • Systems: a Trading Karma trust system, a clan, a Steam group, and a private game server.
  • Channel architecture: restructured the server around what members actually use.
  • Responsive management: "you asked, we listened" changes driven by member feedback.
  • Growth: retention analysis, marketing, and a partnership with a game-studio community.

// From the network — my posts & systems

Systems & levelingNetwork-wide changes, clan, and leveling — signed as Board of Directors.
Systems + responseTrading Karma trust system and feedback-driven restructures.
ArchitectureChannel structure across the network's game categories.
Progression designStaff, honorary, and activity-based role tiers.

Full growth & retention metrics available on request.
